q: Why is the result smaller in pixels?
a: A small file has room for only so much detail. When lowering the quality is not enough, the image is scaled down so it stays clear instead of turning blocky.

q: It says it cannot open my photo.
a: Some browsers cannot open HEIC photos from iPhones. Safari on a Mac can. On the iPhone, Settings, Camera, Formats, Most Compatible makes the camera save JPG photos instead.
Forms and websites accept it almost everywhere, and it makes the smallest files for photos.
